title: QueryResponse
description: Query response containing the generated answer, source chunks, and rewritten queries.

template.description: The template id the answer was generated with; absent when none was used.

template_version.description: That template's declared version. Bumped on any content change.

template_hash.description: Content hash of the template SOURCE, computed at load — not of a rendered body, which would depend on this request's template_vars and could not be computed at load at all. Present only when a templated generation actually produced the answer. See prompt_templates_response.json.

model.description: The registered model id the answer was actually generated with, after the per-request `llm` override and the server default are resolved. Echoed rather than assumed: a template does NOT pin a model (ADR-0008 decision 5), so this is how a degraded result is attributed to a swapped default instead of being mistaken for a prompt regression.
